# New Wave

> AI speeds up the work. Understanding people, culture, and craft is what sets it apart. The site has two sections: NwWv Agency & Consulting, and the Design Resource. Run by creative directors in the United States.

## NwWv Agency & Consulting
Paid social creative for Meta and TikTok, grounded in real audience insight. Fewer, better ads, tested until they cut through the noise. Hiring the studio is not part of membership. Inquire at the form on the homepage. The studio replies by email. The form does not email the inquirer automatically.

- Creative Audit, $750. Start here. Up to 20 Meta and TikTok ads, each marked cut, keep, make, or test. Three test briefs, a 10-minute recorded walkthrough, and a 30-minute call. 5 business days. The full fee counts toward setup and the first month if Backstop starts within 30 days.
- Backstop retainers. Core $600/mo (12 paid-social ads and 10 variants, 2 channels, creative director sign-off). Plus $1,000/mo (20 ads and 25 variants, 3 channels, creative director sign-off). Premium $1,500/mo (everything in Plus, plus a monthly campaign concept, a web or landing-page refresh, a monthly creative director note, and a short kickoff call). $500 setup on Core, Plus, and Premium. Roster capped at 8 clients.
- Full Agency $9,500/mo plus $2,500 setup, limited to 2 clients. Brand strategy and identity stewardship, monthly content calendar across 3–4 platforms, paid ad creative with weekly refreshes, website and landing-page updates, email and newsletter design, a monthly campaign concept, monthly performance report, one monthly strategy call, 2-business-day turnaround. Media spend and ad account management are not included.
- Launch Round, $1,800. One concept, three angles, 6–8 test ads, a 2-week test plan, and a winner readout. Ads in 2 weeks. Setup fee waived if they continue.
- AI Creative Workflow Setup, $3,500. Workshop only, $1,500. The team keeps making the ads. Tool picks, prompt and brand library, QA checklist, sign-off steps, testing cadence, live training. 3 weeks.
- Creative Director Advisory, $1,500/mo. Two calls a month, written feedback on up to 10 concepts a week, and a monthly keep / kill / next note.
- Process: Insight (human, audience and culture), Make (agent), Test (agent), Pick (human), Refresh (human).

## The Design Resource
The AI stack for professional designers. Weekly Use / Skip / Watch verdicts, membership, and agent recipes.

- Creative AI Stack newsletter (weekly, Tuesdays): free top 3 verdicts; paid $12/mo or $120/yr (founding $8/mo for first 100); student $5/mo or $48/yr. Paid includes the Weekly Stack, Case Studies, and 30% off Agent Recipes. The public Weekly Stack is a teaser. The full stack is Paid.
- Case Study Nº 01: how New Wave uses AI agents to win Backstop clients. Public counts are unpublished (shown as em dashes, live from week 1). The full breakdown is Paid. Later case studies come from Paid-member briefs. Not included with Free or Student. The case study is separate from the Backstop offers.
- Agent recipe library: outlined n8n, Zapier, and Claude workflows, not yet tested, $29-99 each, bundles $99-149, Recipe Club $20/mo. Paid members save 30% on every recipe.

## Editorial independence
- Verdicts are never for sale. No pay-to-remove.
- All paid placements are labeled Sponsored, Featured, or Affiliate and sit apart from verdicts.
- Affiliate links only on tools rated Use.
